name: Sergio Roberto Mortara
office: City of Hawthorne, Member of the City Council

items.text: Sergio Roberto Mortara says he is a small business owner in food manufacturing and importing and a 13-year member of the Hawthorne School District Board of Trustees.

sentences.text: Sergio Roberto Mortara says he is a small business owner in food manufacturing and importing and a 13-year member of the Hawthorne School District Board of Trustees.

items.text: His campaign website says he supports the police department and wants to put officers where they are needed most. He plans to address homelessness and keep streets and parks clean. He proposes lowering barriers for local small businesses. He wants to move economic development projects forward to create jobs. He also supports running City Hall with fiscal responsibility and clear communication.
